scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @fingerpay/contracts typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/frontend/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @fingerpay/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @fingerpay/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @fingerpay/backend build && vite build packages/frontend --config packages/frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.emulators: pnpm dlx firebase-tools@15.35.0 --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:start --project demo-fingerpay --only auth,firestore
scripts.test:phase2: vitest run packages/shared/test packages/backend/test && node scripts/phase2-integration.mjs
